plugins.name: dazzer
plugins.description: Makes your AI check your Dazzer Brain before answering and save what settles. Safe to install alongside an existing connection - it adds no connection of its own.

plugins.name: dazzer-connect
plugins.description: The Dazzer Brain connection itself, for people who have not already connected one. Skip this if Dazzer already shows as connected.

plugins.name: dazzer-antigravity
plugins.description: The Dazzer reminders in the one shape Antigravity accepts. Only for Antigravity, and only alongside the main plugin - every other tool reads its reminders from that one.
